## Universal table (target → code + digital trim, trim never negative)

Rule (spec-audio-test-set.md, PW 09-16): hw = largest MEAN hardware gain ≤ target; trim = target − hw. "Edge error" = the gain error a channel at the spread's edge sees at that code (max of mean−min and max−mean); the sign convention: a channel at the max edge is that much HOT.
